items.title: Trump says 'Stupidity causes inflation' and threatens to stop trade with foreign countries - fortune.com
items.reason: Both articles cover the same Friday Oval Office/Truth Social event where Trump reacted to the August jobs report by threatening to halt trade unless the Fed cuts rates. The incoming article adds quotes ('Stupidity causes inflation') and political framing/economic commentary but no new facts about outcomes, decisions, or consequences beyond what's already in the canonical article.

items.title: U.S. labor market booms, with 162,000 jobs added in August - Axios
novel_facts: Women accounted for almost all job gains
items.reason: This is a separate monthly jobs report (August 2026, 162,000 jobs, 4.1% unemployment) distinct from the candidate's May 2026 report (172,000 jobs, 4.3% unemployment). Different reference month and different figures mean this is a new recurring economic data release, not the same real-world event.

items.title: U.S. envoys arrive in Moscow to revive peace talks with Ukraine
novel_facts: Envoys have now actually arrived in Moscow (confirmed, not just planned)
Putin authorized a 72-hour pause on strikes against Kyiv to facilitate the visit
items.reason: Same real-world event (Witkoff/Kushner Moscow trip for peace talks) as the candidate, which previously reported the planned weekend visit. The incoming article confirms the arrival occurred and adds a new concrete fact (72-hour strike pause on Kyiv), which is a material update but not a distinct accountability or consequence story warranting a new URL.
